posts.text: Hi Rahil, Thanks a lot for the note, enjoyed reading it. I had a few questions I struggled to get to my head around: If the market is truly supply constrained, why is ABS able to acquire these ships at attractive rates. ABS said in their conference call that most vessel owners are big companies like Greatship and Shipping Corporation. Why aren’t these players competing for the bids that ABS is winning and are they expanding capacity?
